Card Q&A.a: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays a token that's treated as a Digimon named [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect by deleting a [Diaboromon] token when this Digimon is about to be deleted?

Card Q&A.a: No. this card's [All Turns] effect only takes effect when this Digimon is deleted. You can't activate it when a [Diaboromon] token is deleted.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when one of my [Diaboromon] tokens is about to be deleted?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes. The token is considered a Digimon with the specified name, and is deleted.
